notes: Meets at 4420 Warwick Boulevard, Kansas City, MO. You must get yourself to meetings and events. Page does not say which month applications open.
name: Teen Arts Council
what_you_do: Teen leaders work with museum staff to plan and promote museum programs.
who_can_apply: Any high school student in the Kansas City metro area, any art form. If picked for an interview you must be free in August.
pay_detail: $100 per month stipend. Free to join.
duration: Alternate Thursdays 4:30 to 6:30 p.m., Sept to Nov and Jan to May (2026-27)
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 term are closed. Interviews were in August 2026. Next application dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the form on the KemperTeens site when it opens again. Then interview in August.
